assets.setting: airy studio with soft natural light and a cream backdrop
assets.outfit: cream knit mock-neck sweater (matches the Maplehouse 'Diana' mockneck style)
assets.pose: seated, head tilted, fashion-editorial pose
assets.humor: unexpectedly elegant, like a magazine cover shoot; a single tennis ball as a prop

assets.setting: cozy dorm common room with a worn leather chair and a window onto snowy courtyard
assets.outfit: classic navy Yale crewneck sweatshirt with white arched YALE lettering
assets.pose: sitting upright, chest out, proudly modeling the sweatshirt
assets.humor: looks like he just won a sweater contest; one paw on a folded stack of spare crewnecks

assets.setting: bright college bedroom floor with a rug, morning light
assets.outfit: an ENORMOUS oversized navy Yale hoodie, many sizes too big
assets.pose: almost swallowed by the hoodie: only his face pokes out of the hood opening, sleeves pooling far past his paws
assets.humor: comically lost inside the giant hoodie yet completely content; hood drawstrings dangling on his nose

assets.setting: breezy fall sidewalk on a college street, leaves blowing
assets.outfit: navy collegiate bomber / full-zip jacket with a small YALE chest mark, collar popped
assets.pose: mid-stride strut toward camera like a runway model
assets.humor: wind ruffles his jowls; he wears it like a varsity legend

assets.setting: outdoor stadium running track at dawn, light mist
assets.outfit: navy long-sleeve athletic performance shirt with YALE and BULLDOGS lettering
assets.pose: powerful warm-up jog, ears flapping, motion blur on background
assets.humor: intensely serious athlete face, slightly out of breath

assets.setting: sunny green lawn with picnic blanket and frisbee
assets.outfit: heather gray Yale T-shirt with navy YALE lettering
assets.pose: lying on the blanket, frisbee in mouth, tail wagging
assets.humor: classic carefree summer-on-the-quad energy

assets.setting: festive kitchen with a gift box and tissue paper
assets.outfit: navy hoodie with YALE and small AUNT lettering, string of pearls
assets.pose: presenting a wrapped gift with a paw
assets.humor: the 'fun aunt' who spoils everyone; party hat askew

assets.setting: backyard with a basketball hoop at golden hour
assets.outfit: gray crewneck with YALE and BROTHER lettering
assets.pose: playful bow mid-game, basketball at paws
assets.humor: big-brother bravado, about to steal the ball

assets.setting: family reunion picnic table with lemonade
assets.outfit: gray crewneck with YALE and COUSIN lettering
assets.pose: sneaking a hot dog off the table
assets.humor: the mischievous cousin caught mid-heist

assets.setting: suburban driveway with a grill and lawn chair
assets.outfit: gray YALE DAD crewneck, reading glasses, grilling apron over it
assets.pose: flipping burgers with tongs, proud stance
assets.humor: peak dad energy: dad-joke grin and a spatula

assets.setting: sunlit living room with knitting basket and armchair
assets.outfit: navy YALE GRANDMA hoodie, half-moon glasses
assets.pose: knitting a tiny Yale-blue scarf with yarn tangled around a paw
assets.humor: charming and a little bewildered by the yarn

assets.setting: wood-paneled den with a fireplace and an old radio
assets.outfit: gray YALE GRANDPA crewneck, tweed flat cap, cardigan
assets.pose: settled in an armchair, newspaper on lap
assets.humor: distinguished elder dozing mid-story

assets.setting: bright kitchen with a 'proud of you' refrigerator full of drawings
assets.outfit: navy YALE MOM hoodie
assets.pose: sitting tall beside a framed graduation photo (photo shows a bulldog puppy)
assets.humor: beaming proud mom

assets.setting: lakeside dock with fishing gear
assets.outfit: navy YALE UNCLE hoodie, bucket hat with lures
assets.pose: holding a fishing rod, tiny fish on the line
assets.humor: the uncle with the tall tales: 'it was THIS big'

assets.setting: concrete studio space inspired by Rudolph Hall's brutalist interiors, drafting tables
assets.outfit: black turtleneck, round architect glasses, small School of Architecture shield on chest
assets.pose: proudly presenting an ambitious white foam-core model of a doghouse skyscraper
assets.humor: very serious about his oversized model

assets.setting: messy painting studio with canvases and paint-splattered floor
assets.outfit: paint-splattered smock over a navy sweater with the School of Art shield
assets.pose: standing before a giant abstract canvas, paintbrush in mouth, paw prints everywhere
assets.humor: the abstract 'masterpiece' is clearly made of paw prints

assets.setting: quiet, sunlit colonnaded quadrangle inspired by Sterling Divinity Quadrangle, white columns and lawn
assets.outfit: navy cardigan with the Divinity School shield
assets.pose: sitting peacefully on a bench beside an open (untitled) book, gazing thoughtfully
assets.humor: gentle and serene; a butterfly on his nose; respectful, never mocking

assets.setting: bright maker lab with 3D printers, circuit boards and a small robot arm
assets.outfit: safety goggles pushed up, navy lab hoodie with the Engineering & Applied Science shield
assets.pose: operating a small robot that is handing him a tennis ball
assets.humor: engineered the perfect fetch machine

assets.setting: deep green New England forest inspired by Yale-Myers Forest, ferns and stone wall
assets.outfit: field vest with the School of the Environment shield patch, rain boots
assets.pose: doing fieldwork: measuring a tree with a tape, carrying a very excellent stick
assets.humor: takes the stick sampling extremely seriously

assets.setting: grand wood-paneled law library with tall windows and towering shelves
assets.outfit: tailored navy suit jacket and tie with the Law School shield
assets.pose: standing on a stack of enormous (untitled) law books, paw raised as if objecting
assets.humor: 'Objection!' energy: a tiny gavel nearby

assets.setting: sleek glass-and-steel modern business school atrium inspired by Evans Hall, bright and airy
assets.outfit: sharp navy blazer, crisp shirt and tie, School of Management shield on the blazer pocket
assets.pose: executive pose at a glass table, presenting a bar chart on a laptop where the bars are dog bones
assets.humor: CEO of Treats Inc.: dog-bone bar chart trending up

assets.setting: modern research lab with microscopes and soft clinical light
assets.outfit: light blue scrubs and white coat with the School of Medicine shield, stethoscope
assets.pose: listening with the stethoscope to a plush teddy bear patient
assets.humor: very gentle bedside manner; respectful, not gross

assets.setting: elegant recital hall stage with warm lights and a grand piano
assets.outfit: concert black tuxedo with the School of Music shield pin
assets.pose: conducting with a baton (a chew stick), sheet music on the stand
assets.humor: conducting with dramatic flair, ears flying

assets.setting: bright clinical simulation lab with a hospital bed and monitors
assets.outfit: navy scrubs with the School of Nursing shield and a lanyard
assets.pose: carefully checking a training mannequin's chart on a clipboard
assets.humor: diligent and caring; respectful clinical learning

assets.setting: community health fair booth outdoors with charts and a data dashboard on a screen
assets.outfit: navy polo with the School of Public Health shield
assets.pose: pointing a paw at an epidemiology curve on the screen
assets.humor: earnest data-driven Dan; a 'wash your paws' poster vibe (no readable text)

assets.setting: indoor natatorium with a high diving board and Yale-blue lane ropes
assets.outfit: Yale swim cap and goggles
assets.pose: mid-air off the diving board in a tucked flip, water far below
assets.humor: fearless cannonball form, ears streaming upward

assets.setting: fencing strip in a historic gymnasium with dramatic light
assets.outfit: full fencing whites and mesh mask pushed up, Yale blue trim
assets.pose: en garde lunge with a foil
assets.humor: noble and theatrical, an Ivy duelist

assets.setting: bright blue artificial TURF field with goal cage (NOT ice)
assets.outfit: Yale field hockey kit with kilt-style skort, shin guards, mouthguard
assets.pose: dribbling a field hockey ball with a proper field hockey stick, low and fast
assets.humor: fierce focus, tongue out

assets.setting: manicured green golf course with rolling hills at golden hour
assets.outfit: preppy argyle sweater vest, white polo, flat cap
assets.pose: finishing a golf swing, watching the ball fly
assets.humor: country-club smugness; caddy bag of tennis balls

assets.setting: grass lacrosse stadium on a sunny spring afternoon, crowd blurred
assets.outfit: Yale lacrosse helmet, gloves, navy jersey
assets.pose: dynamic sprint cradling the ball in a correctly strung lacrosse stick, dodging
assets.humor: unstoppable charge; one ear flipped inside out

assets.setting: small racing sailboat on a sparkling harbor, other boats in distance
assets.outfit: navy sailing jacket and life vest
assets.pose: hiking out over the side holding the mainsheet, plausible rigging
assets.humor: salty sea-dog skipper, jowls in the wind

assets.setting: white glass-backed indoor squash court with red lines
assets.outfit: white athletic polo, Yale blue shorts, protective eyewear
assets.pose: lunging for a shot with a squash racquet
assets.humor: dramatic diving get; tiny squash ball

assets.setting: outdoor hard tennis court, bright summer day
assets.outfit: crisp tennis whites, Yale blue headband
assets.pose: leaping forehand with a tennis racquet
assets.humor: obviously tempted to chase the ball instead of hitting it

assets.setting: red outdoor running track with lane lines, stadium in background
assets.outfit: Yale singlet and racing bib (no numbers needed)
assets.pose: explosive sprint out of starting blocks
assets.humor: determined bulldog sprinter, surprisingly fast

assets.setting: indoor volleyball court with net and bright gym lights
assets.outfit: Yale volleyball jersey and knee pads
assets.pose: leaping at the net to block a spike, paws high
assets.humor: huge airtime for a bulldog; teammates' shadows blurred
